import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path('/experiment/dependency-transfer-local')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('dependency', root / 'flatpak_dependency_cache.py')
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
def run(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(list(map(str, args)), text=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=60).strip()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=root, prefix='fixture-') as directory:
    temporary = Path(directory)
    payload = temporary / 'payload'
    payload.mkdir()
    (payload / 'executable').write_text('#!/bin/sh\nprintf fixture\n')
    (payload / 'executable').chmod(0o755)
    (payload / 'data').write_bytes(b'OSTree data payload\n')
    (payload / 'link').symlink_to('data')
    original = temporary / 'source'
    run('ostree', '--repo=' + str(original), 'init', '--mode=bare-user-only')
    commit = run('ostree', '--repo=' + str(original), 'commit', '--tree=dir=' + str(payload), '--branch=fixture', '--subject=archive fixture')
    profile = {'source': 'fixture', 'sdk': 'local-ostree-not-hosted'}
    archive = temporary / 'artifact'
    packed = module.pack(original, archive, profile)
    restored = temporary / 'restored'
    unpacked = module.restore(archive, restored, profile)
    restored_commit = run('ostree', '--repo=' + str(restored), 'rev-parse', 'fixture')
    assert restored_commit == commit
    checkout = temporary / 'checkout'
    run('ostree', '--repo=' + str(restored), 'checkout', '--user-mode', commit, checkout)
    assert (checkout / 'data').read_bytes() == (payload / 'data').read_bytes()
    assert (checkout / 'link').readlink() == Path('data')
    assert (checkout / 'executable').stat().st_mode & 0o111 == 0o111
    result = {'status': 'success', 'versions': run('ostree', '--version'), 'commit': commit,
              'restored_commit': restored_commit, 'pack': packed, 'restore': unpacked,
              'checks': ['real OSTree commit and fsck', 'same restored ref/commit', 'checkout data bytes', 'symlink payload', 'executable mode'],
              'limits': 'Small real local OSTree repository; not actual Flatpak cache, full application, SDK sandbox, hosted transport or performance cohort.'}
    (root / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
